output.reason: [ev-093b8f2b924f] says internal-resource observability is disabled by default in v3 and is re-enabled separately for AccessLogs, Metrics or Tracing via addInternals. Each signal is affected independently, so exposure is when any of them is left unset, not only when all are; the proposed 'all' misses exposed environments. Only logs.access.addInternals is shown to be a chart values key [ev-3bdc943d6be1, ev-bb4a9dd096f3]. The evidence does not show the metrics and tracing Helm paths, so those are expressed as undecidable rather than guessed.

correction.statement: In Traefik v3, observability for internal routers/services (e.g. ping@internal) is disabled by default; it is exposed wherever addInternals is not set for any of AccessLogs (logs.access.addInternals), Metrics or Tracing, each independently.
